description: This file contains logging method definitions for the ActivationRepartitioner class within the Orleans runtime, specifically related to the repartitioning and exchange protocol processes. It defines various partial methods decorated with LoggerMessage attributes for structured logging at different levels (Debug, Trace, Warning).

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: A partial class responsible for handling activation repartitioning logic within Orleans, with logging methods for protocol events.

methods.name: LogPeriodicallyInvokeProtocol
methods.description: Logs the initiation of the periodic exchange protocol with specified timing parameters.

methods.name: LogSingleSiloCluster
methods.description: Logs a message indicating that the cluster has only one silo and is waiting for more to join.

methods.name: LogExchangeSetIsEmpty
methods.description: Logs that the exchange set for a candidate silo is empty and the system will try the next candidate.

methods.name: LogBeginningProtocol
methods.description: Logs the start of an exchange protocol between the current silo and a candidate silo.

methods.name: LogExchangedRecently
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request was received but the silo was recently involved in another exchange.

methods.name: LogExchangedRecentlyResponse
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request was rejected due to recent involvement in another exchange.

methods.name: LogMutualExchangeAttempt
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request was rejected because an exchange is already in progress with that host.

methods.name: LogMutualExchangeAttemptResponse
methods.description: Logs that an exchange request was superseded by a mutual exchange attempt.

methods.name: LogProtocolFinalized
methods.description: Logs the finalization of an exchange protocol, including counts of activations migrated.

methods.name: LogProtocolFinalizedTrace
methods.description: Trace-level log of the finalized exchange protocol with detailed activation migration info.

methods.name: LogErrorOnProtocolExecution
methods.description: Logs an error encountered during the execution of an exchange protocol.

methods.name: LogErrorOnMigratingActivations
methods.description: Logs an error during migration of exchange set.

methods.name: LogReceivedExchangeRequest
methods.description: Logs receipt of an accept exchange request, including counts of activations.

methods.name: LogImbalance
methods.description: Logs the imbalance between remote and local activation counts.

methods.name: LogTransferSetComputed
methods.description: Logs the time taken to compute the transfer set and the anticipated imbalance after transfer.

methods.name: LogErrorAcceptingExchangeRequest
methods.description: Logs an error encountered when accepting an exchange request.

methods.name: LogCoolingDown
methods.description: Logs the cooldown period before initiating the next exchange protocol.

methods.name: LogAddingAnchoredGrains
methods.description: Logs the addition of newly anchored grains to the set on a host.

methods.name: LogComputedCandidateSets
methods.description: Logs the time taken to compute candidate sets.

methods.name: LogComputedCandidateHeaps
methods.description: Logs the time taken to create candidate heaps.
